ownership.allocateMemory: 2000 slots, 9616 cells; independent 8 buffers plus 2 calloc labels per cell. realloc ignored; old allocations remain live.
ownership.copyPSR: distinct pulsar objects; source strings terminated; ordinary jump bound copied from source and inclusive; FD bound retained destination and inclusive. Shared observation owner handled once by harness; interior buffers detached before destruction.
ownership.destroyMemory: slot order; all labels/shortlabels per current aSize then val err prefit prefitErr fitFlag paramSet label shortlabel.
ownership.destroyOne: if obsn free; free_blas covar; each of 2000 constraint_special pointers independently; destroyMemory. Never inspect pointers after destruction.
ownership.initialiseOne: new observation malloc, real 10000x10000 covariance, 2000 parameter owners; repeated call overwrites pointers without freeing. Save aliases first; release old owners separately after observation.
ownership.nested: FitInfo/FitOutput/storePrec/tzrobs untouched; callback identities valid fixture functions, never invoked. Opaque pointer targets fixture-owned.
